sources: https://www.maquoketaia.com/1261/Horseshoe-Pond-Dog-Park-Campground (City of Maquoketa page: reservable and first-come, $25/night or $160/week, phone), read 2026-11-03
https://www.maquoketaia.com/DocumentCenter/View/1165/Horseshoe-Pond-FAQ (site count, reservable site numbers, amperage, pad lengths, dump station, season, 14-day limit), read 2026-11-03

https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/HorseshoePondCampground (Firefly booking page: 'Reservations for the 2027 camping season will be available in January 2027'; equipment types include Motorhome Class C), read 2026-11-03

hookups.source: https://www.maquoketaia.com/DocumentCenter/View/1165/Horseshoe-Pond-FAQ ('Each site in the main campground area has two 50 amp breakers, one 30 amp breaker, and one 20 amp breaker. The four sites located by the pond have one 30 amp breaker and one 20 amp breaker.'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: 19 back-in and 3 pull-through sites, all electric; pads 40-50 ft. Four 30/20-amp sites sit at the end of the road south of the pond.

sites.source: https://www.maquoketaia.com/DocumentCenter/View/1165/Horseshoe-Pond-FAQ ('There are 22 RV campsites', '19 sites are back-in, and 3 sites are pull-through', 'Each campground site has a pad between 40-50 feet'), read 2026-11-03

facilities.source: https://www.maquoketaia.com/DocumentCenter/View/1165/Horseshoe-Pond-FAQ ('Yes, there is a sanitary dump station', 'There is no charge for use of the dump station', 'The dump station has both non-potable rinse water and potable water'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: The FAQ says the campground does not officially close, though water to the restrooms is shut off once it freezes; the city's park page describes it as a campsite 'during the Spring, Summer, and Fall'.

season.source: https://www.maquoketaia.com/DocumentCenter/View/1165/Horseshoe-Pond-FAQ ('The campground does not officially close, but water is shut off to the restroom facilities once it cold enough outside to freeze.') + https://www.maquoketaia.com/1261/Horseshoe-Pond-Dog-Park-Campground ('serves as a City campsite during the Spring, Summer, and Fall'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Sites 1-11 and 20 book online through Firefly; 12-19 are first-come with self-registration (register and pay within 1 hour of arrival). Firefly: 'Reservations for the 2027 camping season will be available in January 2027.' After 14 days campers must leave for 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.maquoketaia.com/DocumentCenter/View/1165/Horseshoe-Pond-FAQ ('Sites 1-11 and 20 can be reserved online with Firefly', 'Sites 12-19 are first come, first served', 'The maximum length of stay is 14 days') + Firefly page, read 2026-11-03

note: City of Maquoketa park at 905 S Main on the south edge of town, beside a 2-acre pond with a walking path and a fenced dog park; Prairie Creek runs along the south side. The four pond-end sites face the creek woods, with the gravel turnaround between them and the pond. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 ($160/week), 22 electric sites (3 pull-through), 50A main / 30A pond sites, free dump with potable water, Firefly + FCFS. Added max 50 ft, 14-night max, year-round (FAQ). Not waterfront confirmed (pond ~2 acres, turnaround between). Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (not waterfront confirmed): on NAIP and Esri imagery the pond is about 90 x 100 m (~2 acres), so a pond, not a lake. The 'four sites located by the pond' are back-ins at the end of the access road south of the pond, facing away from it; the gravel turnaround, a shelter and the pond's walking path lie between them and the shore (~50 m). The main loops are west of a tree belt. Prairie Creek runs in canopy 15-30 m behind the end pads (narrow, no open bank seen), not a creekside lead.

SEASON: two city pages differ: the FAQ says 'The campground does not officially close'; the park page says it serves as a campsite 'during the Spring, Summer, and Fall'. Written year-round with both in season.note.
BOOKING: Firefly says 'Reservations for the 2027 camping season will be available in January 2027'.
SHOWERS: stored showers=false (note prose) is not stated on any city page read; left alone.
PIN fine: stored pin is in the tree belt between the main loops and the pond, ~125 m from the loops.
